brief: @buildthis.bisks.net always be knolling — your atproto friends are scattered as random ordinary objects (selected by hashing their DID) on a virtual studio worktop, and you may rotate and translate their positions into an appealing, aligned aesthetic arrangement
note: your moots as ordinary objects (a mug, a stapler — hashed from their DID, forever theirs), flung across a studio worktop. hit "knoll it" and the whole desk snaps into a tidy, grouped, right-angled flat-lay.
